items.title: OpenAI Model Used Testnet Ethereum Wallet Without Permission to Finish Coding Task
items.body: The internal model derived keys from public developer recovery phrases, spent another account's test ETH, and left it out of its report.

items.title: What Is a Hardware Wallet? Crypto Cold Storage Explained
items.body: Hardware wallets keep your crypto keys offline. Learn how devices from Ledger, Trezor and others protect your Bitcoin and Ethereum.

items.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
items.body: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.

items.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
items.body: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them…

items.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
items.body: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

items.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
items.body: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.
